THESE PETITIONS, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER
Both these petitions arise out of Crime No.279/2023 of Vidyaranyapura Police Station, Bengaluru City.
2. Crl

. P.No.12099/2023 is preferred by accused No.1 under Section 439 of Cr.P.C and Crl.P.No.12155/2023 is preferred by accused Nos.2 and 3 under Section 438 of Cr.P.C.
3.
Heard both the sides and perused the material on record.
In brief, the case of the prosecution is that accused Nos.2 and 3 are the sisters of accused No.1.
The victim girl is a minor aged about 15 years and she is a relative of accused Nos.1 to 3.

On 26.07.2023 accused Nos.2 and 3 forcibly performed her marriage with accused No.1 in Ganesha Temple situated at Vidyaranyapura and then took her to their house situated at 3rd Cross, Somanna garden, wherein accused No.1 committed forcible penetrative sexual assault on her between 26.07.2023 and 05.09.2023, which act was abetted by accused Nos.2 and 3.
5.

The learned counsel for the petitioners submits that insofar as accused No.1 is concerned, he is not pressing the petition and liberty may be reserved to the said accused to file a fresh petition before the Sessions Court after examination of the victim.

The learned counsel submits that insofar as accused Nos.2 and 3 are concerned, they are falsely implicated and they have NC:
2024:KHC:2144 minor children to look after and if they are arrested and detained in custody, their entire family will suffer.
6.

The learned High Court Government Pleader contends that accused Nos.2 and 3 are instrumental in performing the marriage of the minor girl with accused No.1 and abetted him to commit sexual assault on her and therefore, they have committed a heinous offence.
Hence, he has sought to dismiss the petition.
7. The incident is alleged to have been taken place on 26.07.2023, wherein it is alleged that accused Nos.2 and 3 forcibly performed the marriage of the minor victim with accused No.1.

Thereafter,
accused No.1 is alleged to have committed penetrative sexual assault on the minor girl.
Case is registered on 12.09.2023 based on the victim's statement.

In her statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C., victim girl has stated that accused Nos.2 and 3 have forcibly performed her NC:
2024:KHC:2144 marriage with accused No.1 in one Ganesha Temple and then they have ill-treated her etc.
Hence, it cannot be said that there is no prima facie case against accused Nos.2 and 3.
However, considering that petitioners/accused Nos.2 and 3 are women and they are married and having minor children, their detention in custody or custodial interrogation may not be necessary.
They have undertaken to furnish sufficient surety to ensure their presence before the trial Court.

sentences.text: Hence, by imposing necessary conditions, the relief sought by accused Nos.2 and 3 can be granted.

Accordingly, the following:
ORDER (i) Crl.P.No.12099/2023 preferred by accused No.1 is dismissed as withdrawn,
reserving liberty to him to file a fresh petition before the Sessions Court after completion of the recording of victim's evidence.

(ii) Crl.P.No.12155/2023 is allowed and accused Nos.2 and 3 shall be released on bail in the event of their NC: 2024:KHC:2144 arrest in Crime No.279/2023 of Vidyaranyapura Police Station, Bengaluru City subject to following conditions:
(a) They shall appear before the Investigation Officer within a period of one week from the date of receipt of a copy of this order and shall execute a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- [Rupees Fifty Thousand only] each with two sureties for the likesum.
(b) They shall cooperate with the investigation and shall not tamper with the prosecution witnesses in any manner.
(c) They shall be available for the investigation of the case, whenever required.
(d) They shall furnish proof of their residential address and shall inform the I.O/Court regarding change in the address, if any.
NC: 2024:KHC:2144 (e) They shall appear before the Court on every date of hearing, without fail.
